svg.title: The KV pool over time
svg.desc: In panel a, the share of the KV pool's 2,274 blocks in use on stock vLLM while the KV case's two agent requests of 18k prompt tokens prefill and decode, read about every 0.55 s: 98.7% at 7.7 s, 20 blocks free at 8.3 s, where the KV case sends its voice turn, none freed until 12.6 s, and 50.1% at 13.1 s, once vLLM has preempted agent B so that agent A can grow; in panel b, each request's output tokens, both decoding into the last free blocks until agent B stops at 192 tokens while agent A reaches 812 by 24.5 s.
svg.text: (a) KV pool in use, % of its 2,274 blocks
(b) Output tokens of each agent request
Time since the two agent requests were sent (s)
